# linear_project_status (Resource)

Manages a project status in Linear — where a project stands, workspace-wide.

Destroying the resource archives the status; Linear has no hard delete for project statuses.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "linear_project_status" "in_progress" {
  name     = "In Progress"
  color    = "#0f7488"
  type     = "started"
  position = 2
}

resource "linear_project_status" "maintained" {
  name        = "Maintained"
  description = "Shipped and cared for, with no end date"
  color       = "#4cb782"
  type        = "started"
  position    = 3
  indefinite  = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `color` (String) Colour of the status indicator as a hex string.
- `name` (String) Name of the status, e.g. `In Progress`.
- `position` (Number) Sort position of the status within its category.
- `type` (String) Category the status belongs to — one of `backlog`, `planned`, `started`, `paused`, `completed`, `canceled`.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the status.
- `indefinite` (Boolean) Whether a project may sit in this status indefinitely, so Linear does not nag for an update.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) UUID of the project status.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID.
terraform import linear_project_status.example a1b2c3d4-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
